---
title: "Datasets for Final"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

On this page, you can find many possible datasets to use for the final project. 

```{r}
library(stringr)
all.files <- list.files('data/', pattern = '.csv') %>% 
  str_sort(numeric = T)
one.mean <- all.files[str_detect(all.files, 'one-mean')]
one.prop <- all.files[str_detect(all.files, 'one-prop')]
two.mean <- all.files[str_detect(all.files, 'two-mean')]
two.prop <- all.files[str_detect(all.files, 'two-prop')]
paired <- all.files[str_detect(all.files, 'pair')]
```


## Proportions

::: {layout-ncol=2}

### One Proportion

```{r}
#| output: asis

cat(paste0(
  "- [", one.prop, "]",
  "(data/", one.prop, ")\n"
))
```

### Two Proportions

```{r}
#| output: asis

cat(paste0(
  "- [", two.prop, "]",
  "(data/", two.prop, ")\n"
))
```

:::
